description: This file contains C implementations related to repacking promisor objects in a Git repository, including functions to write object IDs, handle process management for pack-objects, and manage promisor file creation.

methods.description: Handles the process output from pack-objects, creates promisor files, and updates the list of packed objects.

methods.description: Main function to repack promisor objects in a repository given the object names.
